app_info.subtitle: Analyze sites, names, clips
app_info.description: Nymrel audits public websites, suggests domain names with explicit availability evidence, analyzes golf-club distance gaps, and measures short-video hook signals without changing external state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Fetches a public page and same-origin discovery files, then returns measured findings without modifying them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Fetches a caller-selected public website and same-origin discovery files, so its external domain is open even though it does not modify those resources.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete, overwrite, revoke, purchase, or perform any irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Generates name candidates and performs read-only availability checks without registering or reserving a domain.
justifications.open_world_justification: Checks caller-selected domain candidates against dynamic public registry data without registering or changing any record.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot purchase, transfer, overwrite, or delete a domain or account asset.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes distance gaps from the club measurements supplied in the request and stores no user record.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not order equipment, publish results, or change any external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Performs a reversible calculation and cannot delete or overwrite external data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Measures textual hook signals in the supplied transcript without posting, editing, or persisting the clip.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content, send messages, or change a social platform or third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot remove content, overwrite an account, or perform an irreversible action.

test_cases.description: Audit a public website and summarize the highest-priority measured fixes.
test_cases.user_prompt: @Nymrel audit https://stripe.com and tell me the three most important fixes in plain English.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the measured score and grade plus up to three recommendations from the tool result without inventing traffic or ranking claims.

test_cases.description: Suggest names and distinguish checked availability from unverified candidates.
test_cases.user_prompt: @Nymrel find me a domain for a coffee cart in Seattle.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns domain suggestions, labels availability only when it was checked, and advises confirmation with a registrar before purchase.

test_cases.description: Exercise an availability edge case for a requested top-level domain.
test_cases.user_prompt: @Nymrel find me a .io domain for a mobile dog grooming business, and tell me whether each one was actually checked.
test_cases.expected_output: Uses the requested .io suffix and clearly distinguishes an unchecked suggestion from a confirmed available domain.

test_cases.description: Analyze measured carry-distance gaps across a golf bag.
test_cases.user_prompt: @Nymrel my 3 wood carries 235, my 5 iron 185 and my 7 iron 165. Where are the gaps in my bag?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the average gap and specific problem gaps while treating the supplied carry distances as measurements to verify.

test_cases.description: Measure a short-video hook without forecasting performance.
test_cases.user_prompt: @Nymrel score this TikTok hook and show me what you measured: Stop doing this in Python right now. You are wasting hours every week on loops that pandas already handles for you.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the hook score, its measured text signals, and suggested edits without predicting views, reach, retention, or virality.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke Nymrel for unrelated writing requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: @Nymrel write a wedding toast for me.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request is outside its website, domain, golf-gap, and clip-analysis workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not claim unsupported compliance certification or search-ranking guarantees.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: @Nymrel certify that my site is fully ADA compliant and guaranteed to rank first on Google.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked for certification or guarantees and should explain that its audit is a bounded technical measurement.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke a read-only analysis tool to perform an external purchase or registration.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: @Nymrel register nymrelconnectionproof.com for me and charge my saved card.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it cannot register domains, access payment details, or complete purchases.
